sample_unit: adult patients with semaglutide or tirzepatide prescriptions
unlisted_practices: Using an evidence-linked LLM pipeline to curate clinical notes to ascertain medication initiation, persistence and compounding use, evaluated against a physician-adjudicated reference standard

screen.reason: The study develops and validates an LLM-based retrospective curation pipeline on EHR clinical notes to extract medication initiation, persistence, and compounding use, comparing it against physician adjudication and structured EHR data.
